test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Energy Swaraj Yatra Bus has been designed and developed by Dr. Chetan Singh Solanki, who is a professor of_________, which plans to combine synergies of climate change mitigation efforts.
solution:
The correct answer is __**IIT Bombay.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Union Minister** of **Education** travelled from his home to his workplace on the **Energy Swaraj Yatra Bus**.
 
• The bus is outfitted with** solar power** and is fully functional as both a work and living space.
 
• The **IIT Bombay** professor who designed and built the bus, **Dr Chetan Singh Solanki**, is with the Minister.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chetan Singh Solanki** is a researcher, educator, innovator, and instructor for the **Art of Living's happiness programme**.
 
• The concept of the **"Energy Swaraj Yatra" **is based on **"Gandhian beliefs"** in order to combat **climate change** and maintain the sustainability of the energy supply.
 
• Due to the **emergency status** of climate change, public measures are now needed to reduce it.
 
• The goal of the** Energy Swaraj Movement** is to raise public knowledge of the** issue of climate change and encourage participation in its solution.**
